title: Localization descent for the normalized section computation
statement: For a fixed ordinary section witness e, equality of the normalized derived computation maps on flat-term K-flat complexes descends through the derived localization and holds for every complex.

source.place: Tags 06YS and 06YU; resolving-class/localization descent in the quotient section pull transport proof

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YS and 06YU; direct naturality along the flat-term K-flat resolution augmentation, followed by cancellation in the derived source.

from.place: The localization step after extracting the ordinary section witness

proof.text: Package both normalized composites as natural transformations on cochain complexes; their source is localization followed by derived scalar extension and derived pullback. For any complex P, choose a flat-term K-flat resolution P' and retain its cochain quasi-isomorphism q : P' → P. The hypothesis gives equality at P'. Apply both naturality squares to q and substitute this equality. The source map inverts q, so cancellation proves equality at P. No target map or scalar counit is cancelled.

theorem section_pull_normalized_localization_descent {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y)
    (barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ derivedPullback Λ' f ≅
      derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T)
    (e : cY.model.E ⋙ pullback Λ' f ≅ pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E)
    (hflat : ∀ P : CochainComplex (modules Λ Y) ℤ,
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P →
      (∀ i : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (P.X i)) →
      barLam.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          cX.model.T.map ((pullback Λ f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
          cX.model.ε.app (((pullback Λ f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
            (Iso.refl (pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) =
        (derivedPullback Λ' f).map (cY.model.ε.app P) ≫
          (pullback Λ' f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            ((cY.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso e (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)) :
    ∀ P : CochainComplex (modules Λ Y) ℤ,
      barLam.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          cX.model.T.map ((pullback Λ f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
          cX.model.ε.app (((pullback Λ f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
            (Iso.refl (pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) =
        (derivedPullback Λ' f).map (cY.model.ε.app P) ≫
          (pullback Λ' f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            ((cY.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso e (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
